后来,河马爷爷的儿子出远门了。

[P3] 今年，是河马爷爷的好朋友小兔子和小熊来问他：“河马爷爷，我们送您一件什么样的生日礼物好呢？”

河马爷爷说：“给我一个木匣子，边上开个小洞口。”

小兔子和小熊，给河马爷爷做了一个木匣子，边上还开了个圆圆的小洞口。

他们觉得很奇怪，河马爷爷每年

要这礼物干什么？

河马爷爷拿着木匣子向远处走去，小兔子和小熊在后面跟啊，跟啊。

他们来到一片大树林，树林里的树有大有小，有粗有细。每棵树上都挂着一个木匣子，每个木匣子的边上，都有一个小洞口，木匣子都成了小鸟们的巢，各种各样的鸟儿在小洞口飞进飞出，热闹极了。

[P4] 原来，河马爷爷从他的一岁生日
开始，每年都要栽一棵树。六十棵高高
低低、粗粗细细的树，组成了一片美丽
的大树林。而且，河马爷爷每年都在新
栽的树上，挂上一个木匣子做鸟巢，
请鸟儿们来这里安家。
六十棵树，像六十位热情的朋友，
张开热情的臂膀，欢迎着河马爷爷，
也欢迎着小兔子和小熊来到这里。
六十棵树，就像六十根生日蜡
烛，六十根绿色的高大的生日蜡烛。

[P5] 而飞上飞下的鸟儿，像五彩的火焰。
小兔子和小熊乐了，他们对河马爷爷说：“河马爷爷，祝您生日快乐！”
六十棵树，和六十棵树上成千上万只鸟儿也一起唱着歌，歌声在树林里回荡：“河马爷爷，祝您身体健康新，祝您生日快乐……”

[P2] He Ma Grandpa's birthday has come again. He is already sixty years old.
In the past, when He Ma Grandma was still alive, she always asked him: "What kind of birthday gift do you want?"
He Ma Grandpa always said: "Give me a wooden box, with a small hole on the side."
He Ma Grandma has been gone for a long time. Later, it was He Ma Grandpa's son who, every year at this time, would ask him: "Dad, what kind of birthday gift do you want?"
He Ma Grandpa always said: "Give me a wooden box, with a small hole on the side."
Later, He Ma Grandpa's son went away on a long journey.

[P3] This year, it was River Horse Grandpa's good friends, Little Rabbit and Little Bear, who asked him, "Grandpa River Horse, what kind of birthday gift should we give you?"

River Horse Grandpa said, "Give me a wooden box with a small hole on the side."

Little Rabbit and Little Bear made a wooden box for River Horse Grandpa, and even opened a round little hole on the side.

They felt very strange. Why does River Horse Grandpa want this gift every year?

River Horse Grandpa walked with the wooden box toward the distance, and Little Rabbit and Little Bear followed behind, following and following.

They arrived at a big forest. The trees in the forest were of different sizes and thicknesses. On each tree hung a wooden box. On the side of each wooden box, there was a small hole. The wooden boxes had become nests for little birds. Birds of all kinds flew in and out of the small holes, making it very lively.

[P4] Originally, Grandpa Hippo, starting from his first birthday,
has planted one tree every year. Sixty tall and short,
thick and thin trees have formed a beautiful
forest. Moreover, Grandpa Hippo hangs a wooden box as a birdhouse
on each newly planted tree, inviting birds to make their homes here.
Sixty trees, like sixty warm-hearted friends,
open their arms warmly, welcoming Grandpa Hippo,
and also welcoming little rabbit and little bear to come here.
Sixty trees, just like sixty birthday candles,
sixty tall, green birthday candles.

[P5] The birds flying up and down look like colorful flames.
Little Rabbit and Little Bear were delighted. They said to Grandpa Hippo: "Grandpa Hippo, happy birthday!"
Sixty trees, and on those sixty trees, thousands upon thousands of birds sang together. Their songs echoed through the forest: "Grandpa Hippo, wish you good health, happy birthday..."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，显示标题“六十根绿色的生日蜡烛”，并配有拼音标注。
[P2] 本页讲述了河马爷爷每年生日都希望得到一个带小洞口的木匣子，这个习惯源于他已故妻子的询问，如今由儿子延续，但儿子后来出远门了。
[P3] 小兔子和小熊为河马爷爷制作了一个带小洞口的木匣子作为生日礼物，河马爷爷带着它走向远处的树林，那里许多树上都挂着类似的木匣子，已成为鸟儿们的巢穴，场面热闹非凡。
[P4] 本页解释了河马爷爷每年种树并挂鸟巢的习惯，将六十棵树比作六十根绿色的生日蜡烛，画面中河马爷爷、小兔子和小熊站在树林里，树上挂满了鸟巢，鸟儿们在周围飞翔。
[P5] 小兔子和小熊为河马爷爷送上生日祝福，树林中成千上万的鸟儿也齐声歌唱，为河马爷爷庆祝生日，场面温馨热闹。
